subject.title: Guard Skill Workshop update applies against delta drafts

question: Should Skill Workshop update apply fail closed for bodies matching the proposed wrapper and identity heuristics across every service caller?
rationale: The guard prevents destructive replacement, but it intentionally rejects inputs current releases accept; tests can bound known false positives, while only maintainers can approve that compatibility tradeoff as permanent service policy.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Keep the shared validator and current allow cases, split the focused tests, then land after normal checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the rejection policy
options.body: Require more structural evidence of a proposal wrapper before rejecting, reducing false positives at the cost of allowing more malformed drafts through.

options.title: Pause this heuristic guard
options.body: Do not merge until update proposals carry an explicit full-replacement contract or structured metadata that avoids content-shape inference.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Keep the shared validator and current allow cases, split the focused tests, then land after normal checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history owns the central proposal apply/write lifecycle where this compatibility invariant would live.
